description: The long or effectful Execution operations a Node caller above the Execution tier reaches through src/native/execution-door.mjs (executionOp, runUnitInHost): one host process per call, `fgos internal execution <op> --protocol 1`. Implemented by apps/fgos/src/wiring/execution_routes.rs.

invocation.request: The first line of stdin: one JSON object, the op's payload.
invocation.answer: One framed line on stdout: prefix, one JSON object, newline. Every other stdout line is an admission peer frame (contracts/admission-peer) or stray output and is never read as the answer.

exit.0: answered (a run-unit error result is an answer)
exit.3: host-version-mismatch: --protocol is not 1, checked before the op
exit.65: invalid-request: the payload is not a JSON object or misses a field

invocation.peer: run-unit and custody (with admit) ask the caller's case admission port over this process's stdout (requests) and stdin (answers), after the request line. The caller serves it with serveAdmissionPeer; pipes only.

payload.request: the run-unit-request document (contracts/unit-run/run-unit.v1.json); an option outside its list is refused by name
payload.admission: boolean: the caller serves a case admission port; without it the run has none. The two events (unitRunCreated, caseAdmitted) always reach the caller.

run-unit.result: the run-unit-result document: { ok: true, result } or { ok: false, error } (the door rethrows the error's class)

payload.admit: object?, the proposal asked of the peer's admit before the command runs

result.admission: the peer's admit answer, when admit was given; a refused one runs nothing
result.admissionError: { code, message }? the peer could not answer
result.verified: the verify answer, when the command ran
result.custodyError: { code, message }? custody could not be taken

result.verified: { verdict: pass|findings } or { infrastructure: timeout|not-run }, with status, how, tail, durationMs, outputDigest (runVerify)

result.adopt: the adopt verdict lines ({ v, protocol, attemptDir, state, outcome?, pendingStep?, reason? }) or null

result.requested: boolean: a cancel request is on disk for the attempt afterwards
